Gate.description:
How a target's output is checked: an evaluate-stage recipe, run in the environment
that produced the output, since that is the one that can load it.

inputs.description: the recipe inputs that select this format's loader
inputs.title: Inputs

Gate.title: Gate

Target.description: A format ``rightsize quantize --to NAME`` produces with this recipe.

bits_from_input.description: the recipe input that is the output's bits per weight (a mixed-precision target); rightsize quantize sets it from the device when it is not given
bits_from_input.title: Bits From Input

bits_over.description: what that input averages over: the quantized layers with the embedding and head kept 16-bit, or, as Model Optimizer counts, every Linear layer including the output head with only the embedding outside
bits_over.title: Bits Over

embedding_bits.description: bits the input embedding keeps, e.g. 16 where only Linear layers are quantized; empty means the format's own
embedding_bits.title: Embedding Bits

gate.description: how to check the output; --eval runs it

head_bits.description: bits an output head of its own keeps (a tied head is saved once, as the embedding); empty means the format's own
head_bits.title: Head Bits

inputs.description: the recipe inputs that select this format
inputs.title: Inputs

method.description: the family the rules key on (quant.method): fp8, awq, gptq, nvfp4, int8, bnb ...; empty means the size_from format
method.title: Method

name.description: what --to takes: fp8, w4a16, nf4, openvino-int4, ...
name.title: Name

serve_format.description: what a server lists in serve.formats to load the output; empty means no plan serves it
serve_format.title: Serve Format

serve_inputs.description: inputs the serve step needs for this output, e.g. quantization: modelopt
serve_inputs.title: Serve Inputs

size_from.description: the quants/formats.yaml entry that predicts the output size
size_from.title: Size From

weights.description: glob, inside what the recipe writes, for the files the prediction covers; empty means every weight file, not the tokenizer and config beside them
weights.title: Weights

Target.title: Target

file.description: for a config: the file it is written to in the run directory (default <framework>_<name>.<ext>)
file.title: File

language.description: what a config renders to; tests parse python and yaml renders
language.title: Language

run.description: for a config: the command that runs the written file, with {file} for its path; python configs default to 'python {file}', other configs are only written
run.title: Run

targets.description: formats this recipe produces for rightsize quantize --to
targets.title: Targets

verified.description: How far this recipe has been checked against version_tested: 'run' means it was run end to end, 'help' that every flag was checked against the tool's own --help, 'docs' that it was transcribed from the documentation only
verified.title: Verified

writes.description: the inputs naming what this step produces (a file or a directory), checked and measured after a run
writes.title: Writes
